title: Add supplier display and filtering
goal: Show supplier names in the product list and add supplier filtering, after suppliers and product supplier assignment already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product create, edit, list, search, category filter, stock quantity, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, availability label, supplier creation, and product supplier selection behavior remains working.
Product list displays a supplier name for products that have supplier_id assigned to an existing supplier.
Product search/filter widget includes a supplier filter dropdown populated from existing suppliers returned by /api/suppliers.
User can filter products by supplier and see only products assigned to the selected supplier.
Clear/reset returns supplier filter to All Suppliers and reloads the full product list.
Browser/e2e uses products assigned to real supplier ids from the current baseline/API; it does not rely on supplier labels or ids that are not present in the rendered select.
Backend tests for supplier_name and supplier_id filter use explicit shared test data/storage for products and suppliers, so related lookup does not read a different mock file.
constraints: Use --from-run with a successful products-app-supplier-selection run as baseline, for example runs/run-010-products-supplier-selection.
Treat this as extend_existing_behavior: no new screens, applications, resources, or scheme elements are required.
All selected action elements are existing screen/widget-owned actions and must be represented as resolved existing elements, not proposed new elements.
Do not create a second product catalog screen or separate product application.
Preserve supplier management widget and product supplier selection from previous slices.
Do not recreate supplier creation inside the product supplier filter e2e; supplier creation is covered by the previous supplier resource slice and may only be rerun as regression.
Do not change the Supplier model/schema. If mock data is read or extended, it must remain compatible with the current Supplier model, including contact_email when that is the model field.
Do not rewrite existing valid supplier mock records only to change demo names or ids.

Do not modify backend/app/main.py or backend/app/storage/__init__.py for this slice unless existing validation proves wiring is missing; suppliers and products routers/storage wiring already exist in the baseline.
Product service related lookup should use explicit dependency seams or shared test storage so backend tests do not read different mock files for related resources.
Extend existing backend/tests/test_products_api.py and frontend/e2e/products-crud-list-search.spec.js; do not invent product_catalog.spec.js or create duplicate product catalog browser specs.
No product delete, supplier delete, procurement workflows, external integrations, authentication, database migrations, or new dependencies.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Creating suppliers as part of the product display/filter flow.
Adding or changing supplier create/edit behavior beyond preserving previous supplier resource behavior.
Changing product supplier selection behavior from the previous slice except where needed to preserve it.
Purchase orders, contracts, scoring, procurement, external integrations, authentication, or database migrations.
notes: Third split supplier scenario. Run after products-app-supplier-selection.
This slice is about display/filter over an existing product -> supplier relationship, not about creating the relationship itself.
Prefer runtime e2e setup that derives supplier ids/names from /api/suppliers or from the rendered select, then creates/uses products assigned to those ids.
